facts.value: Metro Phoenix, home to ASU’s four main campuses, is one of the fastest growing cities in the U.S. and is full of big opportunities.
As an ASU student, you’ll have access to internships and industry partners so you can start getting practical experience in your field of study while you’re still a student.
Depending which campus you’re on, you’re as little as 10 to 30 minutes away from Sky Harbor International Airport.
